dedupe_keys.name: critical electrical infrastructure annotations from google street view images

description: Critical Electrical Infrastructure Annotations from Google Street View Images is a data set deposited in ocul.spdv by its authors Yasmina Souley Dosso (Carleton University). Annotations of critical electrical infrastructure from 2,221 Google Street View (GSV) images are provided here. Wires and poles observed in the scene were annotated by drawing lines over the wires and polygons encapsulating the poles, and creating a binary mask. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: ZIP, TXT. Size stated: 2647235. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
